visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a pair of hands holding a bunch of fresh baby corn with long green husks and silks. The setting is a bright, modern kitchen with white tiles and a dark countertop. Large Traditional Chinese text overlays describe the theme of the recipe. (2) Multiple baby corn ears are spread across a wooden cutting board. The camera focuses on the vibrant green color and the texture of the husks. The hands pick up several ears to demonstrate their size and quality against the clean kitchen background. (3) The scene shifts to a stainless steel bowl in a white kitchen sink. Water flows from a modern tap as hands wash the corn. The lighting is bright and even. The action shows thorough cleaning of the green husks under running water. (4) In a close-up, the hands use kitchen scissors to trim the excess silks and peel away the outermost layers of the husks. Trimmings fall into the sink or a separate container. The focus remains on the manual prep work and the objects' states. (5) The corn is placed into a black cast-iron pot on an induction cooktop. Hands pour water from a glass measuring cup and sprinkle salt. The scene captures the interaction between the person, the cookware, and the fresh ingredients. (6) The pot is covered with its matching lid. A finger points to the digital display of the induction stove and a pink digital timer. This phase emphasizes the technical steps of the cooking process in a controlled kitchen environment. (7) The final phase shows the pot being opened to reveal steaming hot corn. Tongs are used to lift an ear. The woman appears, wearing a blue checkered apron and glasses, peeling and eating the corn with a satisfied expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 原汁原味、原型食物. [Subtitle]: 蒸玉米筍. [Slogan]: 超級鮮甜好滋味！. [Subtitle]: 來試試這個方法蒸玉米筍. (2) [Subtitle]: 準備12~15支帶殼玉米筍. (3) [Subtitle]: 挑選外殼翠綠色、形狀飽滿、筆直. (4) [Subtitle]: 玉米鬚有光澤、尾端有點褐色、甜度會更高. (5) [Subtitle]: 先初步清洗一遍. (6) [Subtitle]: 先去除較髒的兩三層外皮. [Slogan]: 這樣比較乾淨、減少外層農藥. (7) [Subtitle]: 然後再用剪刀剪掉玉米鬚（保留一小節）. (8) [Subtitle]: 再次清洗乾淨+浸泡. (9) [Slogan]: 用密合度好的鑄鐵鍋加入100ml冷水. [Subtitle]: 適量的鹽. (10) [Subtitle]: 把玉米筍放進來. (11) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋、用中火加熱. (12) [Subtitle]: 看到鍋邊冒出蒸氣（約3分鐘）轉中小火. (13) [Subtitle]: 轉中小火蒸煮10分鐘. (14) [Subtitle]: 時間到關火悶3分鐘. (15) [Subtitle]: 好囉，開蓋！！❤️. [Slogan]: 滿滿的玉米香❤️. (16) [Subtitle]: 先放涼再來剝殼. (17) [Slogan]: 這樣帶殼蒸的玉米筍真的超級好吃！. [Subtitle]: 水分甜味不流失，原汁原味. (18) [Slogan]: 連玉米鬚都很好吃❤️. (19) [Slogan]: 你也可以沾一點點鹽吃會超甜，超好吃喔❤️. (20) [Slogan]: 趕快動手試試看❤️. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female narrator introduces the dish with a cheerful and friendly vocal tone. The background music is an upbeat acoustic folk track featuring rhythmic guitar strumming. The speech rate is moderate, with clear articulation and a positive emotional valence. (2) Sounds of water rushing from a faucet are heard as the corn is washed. The narrator continues her instruction, explaining the selection process. The BGM remains consistent in the background, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the preparation. (3) The distinct 'snip-snip' of scissors cutting through vegetable fibers is audible. This incidental noise is clear and well-integrated into the mix. The narrator's voice maintains a professional yet accessible quality, emphasizing the importance of removing dirty husk layers. (4) A metallic clink occurs as the heavy cast-iron lid is placed onto the pot. The sound of water being poured follows. These technical sound events ground the tutorial in a real-world kitchen environment, despite the studio-clean overall audio quality. (5) A bright digital chime or 'ding' sound effect marks the transition to the cooking timer. The BGM continues with its steady, major-key melody. The narration explains the specific timing for steaming and resting the corn for optimal sweetness. (6) The audio concludes with prominent 'crunch' and 'munch' sounds as the character eats the steamed corn. These ASMR-style incidental noises highlight the texture of the food. The narrator provides a final encouragement and a call to action.

It combines visual step-by-step instructions with encouraging narration to promote healthy cooking while showcasing branded kitchen tools and the creator's platform.
